questions.prompt: A background job prints 200,000 characters and KEEP is 64,000. What does job_output return at the end?
questions.explanation: keep appends then slices to the last KEEP characters, so the newest 64,000 stay. The 2,000-character tail is only what the completion message includes.

questions.prompt: A job finishes while the agent is idle. What happens?
options: Nothing until the person types again
A followup with the exit code and output tail wakes the agent and starts a turn
The job's output is added to the last tool result
The agent is told only on its next model request
questions.explanation: The close handler calls deliver, which sends a followup to an idle agent. A followup wakes it and starts a new turn.

questions.prompt: Why return a job id at once instead of waiting with a long timeout?
options: The agent can keep working, and commands that never end are not killed
Ids are cheaper than tool results
Waiting would break the tool schema
The sandbox only allows short commands
questions.explanation: A blocking call freezes the step and a timeout would kill long or endless commands. Returning an id lets work continue and the result arrive later.
